Molly (PM): Quick heads up — annual planning offsite draft date: Thu May 16, 9am-4:30pm PT. Need to lock facilitation leads + prework by EOD Mon.
Rahul (Staff PM): I'm happy to co-facilitate the roadmap prioritization breakout if needed. Prefer morning slot.
Kevin (Eng Lead): I can take the technical risks & rollout session. Will need 30-45 mins and whiteboard.
Elaine (Design): I can run the customer journey mapping exercise. Will prep artifacts — want a 60m block.
Ryan (People Ops): Confirming room + hybrid AV. Do we need extra mics for remote facilitators?
Molly (PM): Yes @Ryan please reserve hybrid A/V and ensure gallery view. Also need sticky notes + printed prework for everyone.
Rahul (Staff PM): Two quick asks — 1) can we have a shortlist of customer-driven asks to prioritize (ops+security) and 2) a clear launch-criteria template? I can draft both.
Molly (PM): Both yes. Rahul, please draft the shortlist and put it in the prework doc. Use this template section: "Customer ask, user impact, feasibility, rollout risk, metrics".
Kevin (Eng Lead): For rollout risk, we should add "dependencies on Dedicated infra" and "quantization/regression". Will add notes.
Elaine (Design): For journey map facilitation, I'll need prework: 1) 3 customer personas, 2) top use-cases, 3) one example prompt. Can we standardize those in the doc?
Molly (PM): I'll populate personas and top use-cases. Can everyone add their examples by Fri? That lets design synth before Monday.
planning-bot: Poll posted — "Best time for facilitator rehearsal" — options: Tue May 13 10am, Tue May 13 3pm, Wed May 14 11am. React to vote.
Rahul (Staff PM): :thumbsup: going with Tue 10am. Will join rehearsal and run the prioritization dry-run.
Kevin (Eng Lead): 3pm works better for me, remote day. If rehearsal is 10am, can we record?
Ryan (People Ops): Recording enabled + backup mic ordered. QA will test Zoom Rooms on Tue AM.
Molly (PM): Draft run-of-show posted below — pls review and call out gaps. We'll finalize by Monday morning.
Molly (PM): ```
09:00 - 09:15 — Welcome + goals
09:15 - 10:45 — Customer journey mapping (Elaine)
10:45 - 11:00 — Break
11:00 - 12:00 — Roadmap prioritization exercise (Rahul)
12:00 - 12:45 — Lunch
12:45 - 14:00 — Technical risk & rollout planning (Kevin)
14:00 - 14:15 — Break
14:15 - 15:15 — OKR alignment + metrics (Molly)
15:15 - 16:00 — Commitment & next steps, action owners
16:00 - 16:30 — Buffer / async followups
```
Elaine (Design): Looks good. Recommend splitting the journey mapping into 45m mapping + 45m synthesis so we have outputs for prioritization.
Molly (PM): Good call — updating.
Kevin (Eng Lead): Also request 15 mins at end of technical session for "fallback/backstop" policy (quantization + model variant fallbacks). Important for Dedicated customers.
Molly (PM): Added 15m buffer in that slot.
Rahul (Staff PM): For prework doc link: https://docs.redwood/workspaces/annual-offsite-prework — putting in checklist + short prompts. Please add bullet points not long essays.
Ryan (People Ops): Can we collect dietary needs + any travel approvals by Wed? I'll send a separate form.
Molly (PM): Action items: Rahul — shortlist + poll results; Elaine — journey artifacts; Kevin — risk checklist; Ryan — AV + logistics. Everyone: add prework examples by Fri EOD.
Kevin (Eng Lead): Noted. Will add risk checklist.
planning-bot: Reminder scheduled — "Prework due" on Fri at 3pm PT.
Molly (PM): Thanks all. If any blocking constraints (vacation, embargoed topics), flag here or DM me. We'll run a 15m alignment right after rehearsal.
Elaine (Design): Minor note — can we make one breakout remote-only for people in EMEA? Some facilitators prefer timezone-specific groups.
Molly (PM): Yes — we'll carve out a remote EMEA breakout in the final schedule. Thanks.
Rahul (Staff PM): One more: can we agree on launch criteria examples? I'll paste 3 quick templates in the doc tonight.
Molly (PM): Perfect. Closing the thread — will post final agenda Mon morning and send calendar invites.
Kevin (Eng Lead): :rocket:
Ryan (People Ops): :party:
